name: Da Waaagh
who_text: Greenskin warbands: Orcs, Goblins and their kin. The book prints no list; it is written for Greenskins throughout.

scoring.text: Killing a model with the Great Beast rule.
Every three warriors the leader takes out of action in one game.
Taking an enemy leader out of action.
More when that enemy leader was a Greenskin, on top of the point for taking him out of action.
Winning three games in a row. The heading says D3, its text a single point.
Losing three games in a row.
Whenever the leader is taken out of action.
Whenever a warrior is captured. An Orc warband counts only its Orcs.

achievements.name: WAGH!
achievements.text: A Greenskin camp gathers around the warband: its Heroes may now visit Da Camp instead of searching for a rare item, and its leader takes his first prophecy from Da Prophet there.

achievements.name: WAAGH!
achievements.text: The warband's maximum size rises by 2.

achievements.name: WAAAGH!!
achievements.text: You Balong to da Boss Now: once per game, after a member of the warband takes a warrior out of action, he may declare at once that the warrior is captured.

achievements.name: WAAAAGH!!
achievements.text: The warband's maximum size rises by a further 3.

achievements.name: WAAAAAGH
achievements.text: War Chant: once per game the leader may let out a deafening war chant, and for D3 turns every friendly model within range of his Leadership is subject to frenzy and causes fear.

achievements.name: WAAAAAAAGH!!!
achievements.text: Unkillabull: the leader may re-roll any result of Dead on the serious injury chart.

achievements.name: WAAAAAAAAGH!!!!
achievements.text: Not a win by itself. Once the warband has completed all 6 prophecies and has full WAAAGH, it may choose the special scenario Nice Day for a Waaagh Beheadin'; winning it wins the campaign, and losing it costs the leader's warband 2D6 Campaign Points.
